answers.core: One could create a new class derived from the OptionButton and override how the item is selected and focused, but it would be nice to have these features right out of the box.
answers.workaround: Well, keeping the reference of the OptionButton to get the item's id is possible, but in a plugin's UI where the OptionButton is temporary, that is refreshed in some conditions (like the node selectiong changes and a new OptionButton is instantiated with the node's option) a extra variable to just access one function seens a bit strange to me.

title: OptionButton: Change the value returned in the signals "item_focused" and "item_selected"
